expected_outcomes: AI systems participate in implementation without becoming evidence authorities.
required_actions: Load local instructions, inspect code and tests, state uncertainty, plan material changes, keep work bounded, and report exact verification.
acceptance: Destructive, credential, publication, deployment, and policy-exception actions retain human approval.
verification: Inspect the plan, diff, test output, and approval receipt.
evidence: Commands, outputs, commit diff, and residual risks.
failure_conditions: The system invents evidence or performs an approval-required action without authorization.
exceptions: Record the exact approved action, scope, revision, and expiry.
